title: Research best-effort F_7 packed encoding
description:
## Context

⚠ **User approval required** before selecting the winning encoding — this is the input contract for W4 implementation issues T19/T20.

F₇ has 7 elements; the simplest baseline is 3-bit-per-element packed with one redundant codeword (16 elements per `u64`) and a 2¹⁶ LUT for mul. F₇* is cyclic of order 6, which suggests a (log mod 6, zero) representation may permit cheaper multiplication than mul-via-LUT. A 4-bit packed representation (8 elements per `u64`) may also let multiplication exploit XOR-structure on a non-redundant codeword.

This issue prototypes 2–4 candidate encodings in `dev/research/f7_packing/`, measures cycles/op, and produces a decision document.

Hard fallback if no novel encoding beats LUT baseline by ≥ 1.5×: select the 3-bit + LUT baseline.

## Success Criteria

1. [hard] `dev/research/f7_packing/` exists, builds with `cargo build -p f7-packing-prototype --release`.
2. [hard] At least 2 candidate encodings are implemented and benchmarked.
3. [hard] `dev/plans/r2_f7_encoding_decision.md` lands and is attached via `jit doc add`, naming the winning candidate.
4. [hard] Decision doc documents bitwise op counts for add, sub, mul, div on the chosen encoding.
5. [hard] User has signed off (recorded as a comment) before transitioning to `done`.
